title: Does this look like a game you would play?
author: mjkoskinen
selftext: Honest feedback needed! This is my first go at game development and could use your input. I've had the idea for this game for years I'm finally making it a reality! It is a cozy pixel-art space themed RPG. The concept is that humans are evacuating earth to live on mars and search out other plants. The player will make difficult decisions and face the consequences. Get lost in side missions or focus on the main ones depending on your preference. Combat is turn based with dodge/attack timers. Developed using opus 5.5, no game engine, all art is procedural and it runs in the browser. A free playable demo will be coming soon.
